نغتفر (form VIII)
# نَغْتَفِرُ (naḡtafiru) /naɣ.ta.fi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# نُغْتَفَرُ (nuḡtafaru) /nuɣ.ta.fa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# نَغْتَفِرَ (naḡtafira) /naɣ.ta.fi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَفَرَ (iḡtafara)
# نُغْتَفَرَ (nuḡtafara) /nuɣ.ta.fa.ra/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
